items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: A very good friend of ours, a man that was handling Fats then, Phil Ponce, and well, to me he was a great guy.

ctx.x: Well Herman, this recording session you did with Fats was the first one, you say, of a series that Fats did with this small group at Victor. How did this happen? Who was after who? Fats? Or Victor?

Well, here's what happened. A very good friend of ours, a man that was handling Fats then, Phil Ponce, and well, to me he was a great guy. To Fats he was a great guy. You see, in the meantime, Fats was in Cincinnati, working there by himself, and he start --
Was that when he was at WLW?
